intent.raw: /refine we should model and design how this integrates with claude code, codex, and generic runtimes
intent.objective: Run the canonical Refine loop to produce a runtime integration model and design for Inventory Attachment Hook across Codex, Claude Code, and generic runtimes, using chat-invoked managed skill execution as the first proof surface.

route_menu.context_hint: The target has three host runtime lanes with shared Arcanum contracts and runtime-specific surfaces. The proof surface is skill invocation through chat, not editor UI.

items.label: Three-Lane Runtime Model
items.description: Model Codex, Claude Code, and generic runtimes as lane adapters over one shared attachment contract for chat-invoked skills and spells.

items.label: Codex First
items.description: Design Codex chat-invoked skill hooks first and defer Claude/generic runtimes to later parity work.

items.label: Generic First
items.description: Design only the runtime-neutral adapter contract before specializing to Codex and Claude.

technique_overlays.trigger: The design needs the canonical Refine loop with explicit stage receipts and handoffs.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each stage consumes prior evidence and records an artifact or blocked reason.

technique_overlays.trigger: The runtime integration has hidden structure across hooks, generated packages, deterministic wrappers, subagents, and closeout receipts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The model/design must name shared runtime contract components and host-specific surfaces.

technique_overlays.trigger: Codex, Claude Code, and generic runtimes have different hook/subagent/wrapper affordances that must be compared without losing the shared contract.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Runtime lanes must be compared by enforcement strength, portability, generated-surface impact, and fallback behavior.

technique_overlays.trigger: Runtime integration touches host-specific hooks, private repo surfaces, generated mirrors, chat-invoked skill execution, and observability closeout.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Host-specific details must be projected as local adapters without redefining the shared Arcanum contract.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Three runtime lanes need independent pressure before parent synthesis.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use separate lane reviewers for Codex, Claude Code, and generic runtimes so host-specific affordances do not collapse into a Codex-only design. Keep chat-invoked skill execution as the shared proof case.
context: Chat invocation of managed skills and spells through the active agent surface
Codex repo skill and hook surfaces
Claude Code skill and subagent surfaces
generic deterministic wrapper and tools/arcanum adapter boundary

roles.purpose: Model Codex repo skills, chat-invoked skill lifecycle, .codex hooks, Stop-hook closeout, and generated metadata requirements.
roles.owns: Codex lane requirements and validation evidence

roles.purpose: Model Claude Code skills, chat/native skill lifecycle, Claude agents, tool-name translation, and handoff receipt constraints.
roles.owns: Claude Code lane requirements and validation evidence

roles.purpose: Model runtime-neutral wrapper/adapter obligations for chat-hosted executors without native hooks.
roles.owns: generic runtime contract, fallback behavior, and conformance tests

roles.purpose: Guard canonical/generated boundaries, private/public boundaries, and observability recursion safety.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm to run the runtime integration refinement with Codex, Claude Code, generic runtime, and boundary review lanes using chat skill invocation as the proof surface?

agents.residue: Direct $skill-name observation bridge still needs implementation proof.
Claude lane needs native receipt or wrapper evidence.
Generic runtime needs no-native-hook fallback receipt fixture.
Boundary proof remains pre-implementation until fixtures exist.

steps.name: Context Builder Evidence Baseline
stop_conditions: block if hook architecture/spec or runtime source surfaces cannot be read
flag any runtime surface that exists in one host but not another
flag any lane that cannot describe a chat-invoked skill execution path

steps.name: Invoke Define Runtime Integration
stop_conditions: block if the definition makes Codex the universal runtime contract
flag missing Claude Code or generic runtime obligations

steps.name: Interrogation Refine Review
stop_conditions: block if runtime boundaries are unsafe
flag unresolved adapter vocabulary

steps.name: Research Decision
stop_conditions: ask before external research if live product behavior is needed
continue local-first if repository evidence is enough

steps.name: Distill Runtime Contract
convergence_criteria: one shared runtime contract remains host-neutral
Codex, Claude Code, and generic lanes keep only host-specific duties
chat-invoked skill execution recomposes through all runtime lanes
recomposition into Inventory Attachment Hook remains clear
stop_conditions: block if the shared contract cannot recompose into all three runtime lanes
flag runtime-specific obligations that need separate implementation SWUs

steps.name: Invoke Design Runtime Integration
stop_conditions: block if the design lacks a shared contract and three host lanes for chat-invoked skills
flag if validation is only prose and has no fixture or dry-run target

steps.name: Runtime Lane Review
convergence_criteria: runtime lanes agree on the shared contract
each lane demonstrates the chat skill invocation path
each lane names host-specific enforcement and fallback
boundary reviewer finds no canonical/generated or telemetry recursion violation
stop_conditions: block if any lane needs a different shared contract
flag host-specific residue with an owner and route

steps.name: Distill Repair
stop_conditions: block if repaired model cannot serve all three runtime lanes
flag deferred runtime-host implementation work

steps.name: Invoke Plan Refresh
stop_conditions: block if plan refresh bypasses existing SWU order
flag runtime-specific work that should be split into separate SWUs

steps.name: Final Interrogation And Synthesis
stop_conditions: block if final synthesis lacks runtime lane receipts
flag if next route is not bounded

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json must validate before runtime-backed stages execute.
Operator must approve runtime-backed stages and lane review subagents before execution.
Runtime integration design must not make generated packages, host hooks, or telemetry rows into canonical authority.
Model and design must cover Codex, Claude Code, and generic runtime lanes plus one shared host-neutral contract.
Runtime examples and generated-surface notes must not leak private parent-repo material into public Arcanum artifacts.

boundaries.contract: Runtime integration may describe generated outputs, but generated packages are refreshed from canonical sources and are not authority roots.

boundaries.to_owner: Codex, Claude Code, and generic runtime lanes
boundaries.contract: Each host lane projects the same attachment contract into chat-invoked skills, host-specific hooks, wrappers, or agents without redefining the contract.

boundaries.from_owner: host runtime hook, wrapper, or chat invocation adapter
boundaries.contract: Host runtime evidence returns primary result, telemetry status, attachment status, and residue without triggering recursive observation.

authority.execution: host runtime lane after later implementation
authority.memory: Inventory candidate evidence only when later implemented
authority.promotion: owning governance capability through a separate route

state_namespaces.owner: repo Codex generated runtime surface for chat skill invocation
state_namespaces.write_policy: regenerate from canonical source; do not hand-edit
regenerate from canonical source; preserve Claude tool-name translations and agent boundaries
install through bootstrap or runtime installer; do not treat hook telemetry as primary result
deterministic resolver, validator, handoff, and runtime fallback evidence only; legacy adapter compatibility is not required for this route
telemetry, hook operation, dedupe, failure, and closeout evidence

promotion_splits.rule: Design may recommend canonical edits, but implementation requires a later owner route.

promotion_guardrails: Runtime integration design is not runtime implementation.
Generated packages, hooks, and telemetry rows are not canonical authority.
Codex-specific hooks must not become the generic runtime contract.
VS Code, Cursor, editor panel, and command-palette behavior are deferred host-interface projections.
